head: spacedock-ensign/dispatch-close-out-archives-evidence-and-removes-scratch
title: feat(kc-dev-flow-2): archive dispatch evidence and remove scratch
body:
Finished dispatches left temporary checkouts behind and cited evidence could disappear with them. Dispatch records now supply a record-specific scratch folder and close-out command. Close-out keeps cited public evidence in the task folder, gzips files over 256 KiB with original SHA-256 digests, refuses more than 1 MiB retained evidence, then removes the derived scratch root and its registered worktrees. The removal log records uncommitted-file counts. Private evidence is excluded by the worker instruction and replaced with a reproduction command.

The idle task view prompts close-out for older, merged and archived dispatch roots before the merge-record step; unknown task roots are reported without removal. Missing dispatch records, mismatched roots and symlinked roots or parents refuse deletion. ADR 0079 records the approved choices. Scope is the six designed script/test files plus the Captain-authorized ADR; no version or workflow text changes.

Validation:
- Real Spacedock dispatch suite: 49 passed.
- PR watch and scratch suite: 148 passed, including real dirty-worktree removal and committed gzip restoration.
- Dispatch-record suite: 136 passed; the initially skipped native-builder case was rerun with its declared binary and plugin-root inputs.
- Ten behavior mutations were rejected, including the three acceptance-criterion falsifiers.
- Repository skill lint, required ADR lint, number guards, design-surface check and comment-ratio check passed.
- Fresh-shell acceptance: 15 decisive tests and the S4 command passed; this task's real scratch close-out are recorded in the task evidence/report.

Limits: this is a local implementation candidate. No product push, Draft PR, RoboRev or hosted CI has run; FO owns those steps. A real dispatch after publication is still unrun. The newest forgotten scratch root may remain while its task waits at a gate. CI cost per PR was not measured; CI triggers are unchanged, and the new scratch tests run through the existing PR-watch test entry.
